title: PEB Mezzanine Floor for Maria B, Lahore | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 7,020 sq ft PEB mezzanine floor for Maria B in Lahore: 12 ft high, 90 ft wide and 78 ft long.
h1: PEB Mezzanine Floor for Maria B in Lahore: 7,020 Square Feet of Added Floor Area
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered mezzanine floor for Maria B in Lahore. The floor is 12 feet high, 90 feet wide and 78 feet long and covers 7,020 square feet.
alt: Steel mezzanine floor built by Steel Mind for Maria B in Lahore.

faq.q: How big is the Maria B mezzanine?
faq.a: It covers 7,020 square feet and stands 12 feet high.

faq.q: Can a mezzanine be used for display or offices?
faq.a: Yes. The engineer sets the floor load from the use.

blocks.text: A mezzanine gives a retail or production business more floor area without buying more land. Steel Mind designed this floor for Maria B, made the steel in its factory and erected it in Lahore.

The floor was designed for its use. Columns, beams and deck carry the load, and stairs give safe access. A mezzanine in an occupied building also needs a careful work plan, so crews keep the area safe and tidy during erection.
Steel Mind builds mezzanines for commercial users and not only for factories. It is a good example for brands that want more floor area quickly.
